panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Radiograph showing a lateral view of the DIP joint injury (dislocation/fracture) as presented in the case report of FDP avulsion, relating to the focus of the article. B: This central panel explicitly shows the finding pointed to by the arrow, consistent with the description of a displaced DIP joint and related avulsion in the context of the case report on FDP avulsion. C: Providing additional radiographic evidence of the injury described in the case report.
